description: Keeps a session from changing parley's trust list or reading its vault itself; those are its person's to change, with /parley:trust and /parley:secret.

hooks.command: if grep -Eq 'parley\.mjs[^|;&]{0,40}[[:space:]]+(trust|secret)([[:space:]\\"]|$)|\.parley/(trusted\.json|vault)' ; then echo "parley's trust list and vault are changed only by your user, who types /parley:trust or /parley:secret. Ask them; do not look for another way." >&2; exit 2; fi
